title: Gotrade Daily: Xi Lands in DC as Nasdaq Hits a Record
summary: Xi Jinping arrives in Washington as the Nasdaq sets another record. Your US watchlist for tonight: NVDA, AAPL, META, PAYX, and NFLX.
body_markdown:
Several big-tech CEOs are expected at the dinner, so US tech stocks may react to any signal from the talks.


## Tonight's Watchlist


Stock Movement What to Watch


[NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) Pre-market % to follow AI-chip exports to China are on the table as Xi meets in Washington.


[AAPL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/aapl/) Pre-market % to follow China is a key market and production base, so trade signals hit fast.


[META](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/meta/) Up 1.5% yesterday Muse AI agent tops the App Store, and the AI trade still drives the Nasdaq.


[PAYX](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/payx/) Reports before the open Consensus EPS of $1.33, read as a signal on US small-business hiring.


[NFLX](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nflx/) Pre-market % to follow HSBC cut the stock to Hold and lowered its target to $76.


## Tonight's Catalysts


### Xi's US state visit begins


Xi lands today, with the main meeting and state dinner on Thursday. Trade, rare earths, and AI directly touch **Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** , **Apple ([AAPL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/aapl/) )** , and **Tesla ([TSLA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/tsla/) )** . Markets will parse every official statement for signs of easing or tightening on trade.


### Meta Muse keeps the AI trade alive


**Meta ([META](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/meta/) )** rose 1.5% after Monday's 11% jump, powered by its Muse AI agent overtaking ChatGPT at the top of the App Store. The ripple spread elsewhere: insurers such as **Allstate ([ALL](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/all/) )** and **Progressive ([PGR](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/pgr/) )** fell because Muse can compare car-insurance quotes.
